record_title: Mixed cluster joins sharpen the clique partition-cover deficit
limitations: The finite capacity conditions are sufficient rather than necessary. The coefficient 3/2^(5/3) is an explicit construction upper bound for the normalized deficit and is not claimed optimal. The known Theta(n^(4/3)) order and the cut lower bound are prior work. Older literature under different clique-decomposition terminology and very recent unindexed work remain residual originality risks. Finite verification supports but does not replace the symbolic proof. No independent validation is asserted.
